general_background.title: Tributylphosphine as a chalcogen carrier
general_background.summary: Tributylphosphine can react with elemental chalcogen to form a soluble molecular phosphine chalcogenide feed. When that feed supplies growing nanocrystals, its conversion rate affects the availability of chalcogen for nucleation and growth.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: Molecular Control of the Nanoscale: Effect of Phosphine–Chalcogenide Reactivity on CdS–CdSe Nanocrystal Composition and Morphology

general_background.title: A reactive organocadmium feed
general_background.summary: Dimethylcadmium can supply cadmium directly in a hot-injection route instead of requiring an oxide to dissolve and form a complex first. Its different activation chemistry can change how quickly the mixture becomes supersaturated and nucleates.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: Synthesis and characterization of nearly monodisperse CdE (E = sulfur, selenium, tellurium) semiconductor nanocrystallites

general_background.title: Technical-grade TOPO is not always chemically equivalent to purified TOPO
general_background.summary: Phosphorus-containing impurities in technical-grade TOPO can change cadmium precursor coordination and surface binding during colloidal growth. They can therefore change shape selection without a change in the nominal solvent name.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: The Trouble with TOPO; Identification of Adventitious Impurities Beneficial to the Growth of Cadmium Selenide Quantum Dots, Rods, and Wires

general_background.title: Cadmium phosphonates and elongated growth
general_background.summary: Phosphonic acids can coordinate cadmium and alter the relative growth rates of the surfaces of wurtzite cadmium selenide. When the growth supply sustains that difference, elongation can compete with more uniform growth.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: Mechanisms of the Shape Evolution of CdSe Nanocrystals
